programs.name: wptuncomp
programs.purpose: Decompress a wavelet-packet-compressed array into binary floats.
programs.float_sensitive_notes: Inverse wavelet-packet filtering and dequantization depend on floating-point operation order. The compressed header uses native int and float representations. Input reads are unchecked, so truncated input can leave values uninitialized.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers a padded two-dimensional array and reverses several compression stages and a wavelet-packet transform.

test_cases.description: Decompress a packet-compressed section with default stages.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | sustrip | wptcomp n1=128 n2=16 error=0.01 | wptuncomp > out.bin

test_cases.description: Exercise padding and explicit packet stages.
test_cases.command: suspike nt=100 ntr=9 | sustrip | wptcomp n1=100 n2=9 nstage1=2 nstage2=2 error=0.03 | wptuncomp > out.bin

programs.name: wtcomp
programs.purpose: Compress a binary-float array using a two-dimensional wavelet transform.

params.name: n1
params.description: Number of samples in the fast dimension.

params.name: n2
params.description: Number of samples in the slow dimension.

params.name: nstage1
params.description: Number of transform stages in the fast dimension.

params.name: nstage2
params.description: Number of transform stages in the slow dimension.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Wavelet filtering and quantization depend on floating-point accumulation and rounding; small differences can change encoded integers and the compressed stream. The header uses native int and float representations. Short input reads are unchecked and can leave samples uninitialized.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers and pads a two-dimensional array, transforms it, and applies several encoding stages.

test_cases.description: Compress a section with default transform settings.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | sustrip | wtcomp n1=128 n2=16 error=0.01 > out.wt

test_cases.description: Exercise padding and explicit transform stages.
test_cases.command: suspike nt=100 ntr=9 | sustrip | wtcomp n1=100 n2=9 nfilter=11 nstage1=2 nstage2=2 error=0.03 > out.wt

programs.name: wtuncomp
programs.purpose: Decompress a wavelet-transform-compressed array into binary floats.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: WTUNCOMP - UNCOMPression of WT compressed data
programs.float_sensitive_notes: Inverse wavelet filtering and dequantization depend on floating-point operation order. The compressed header uses native int and float representations. Input reads are unchecked, so truncated input can leave values uninitialized.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers a padded two-dimensional array and reverses several compression stages and a wavelet transform.

test_cases.description: Decompress a section compressed with default stages.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | sustrip | wtcomp n1=128 n2=16 error=0.01 | wtuncomp > out.bin

test_cases.description: Exercise padding and explicit transform stages.
test_cases.command: suspike nt=100 ntr=9 | sustrip | wtcomp n1=100 n2=9 nstage1=2 nstage2=2 error=0.03 | wtuncomp > out.bin

programs.name: wpc1comp2
programs.purpose: Compress each trace of a binary-float section independently using wavelet packets.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: WPC1COMP2 --- COMPress a 2D seismic section trace-by-trace using

params.name: n1
params.description: Number of float samples per trace. The selfdoc calls it required, but the code does not check for its presence; omitting it leaves n1 uninitialized.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Wavelet-packet compression and quantization depend on floating-point calculations and rounding; differences can change the encoded stream. The compressed format is platform dependent. Missing n1 leaves an uninitialized integer, and trailing incomplete traces are ignored.
programs.difficulty_reason: The trace loop delegates wavelet-packet compression and encoding to a substantial compression library.

test_cases.description: Compress multiple traces with the default error.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | sustrip | wpc1comp2 n1=128 error=0.01 > out.wpc1

test_cases.description: Compress a non-power-of-two trace length with a larger error.
test_cases.command: suspike nt=100 ntr=8 | sustrip | wpc1comp2 n1=100 error=0.05 > out.wpc1

programs.name: wpc1uncomp2
programs.purpose: Decompress a section whose traces were independently compressed using wavelet packets.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: WPC1UNCOMP2 --- UNCOMPRESS a 2D seismic section, which has been
programs.float_sensitive_notes: Inverse wavelet-packet calculations depend on floating-point operation order. The compressed format is platform dependent. The first read is not checked for NULL before obtaining its sample count; subsequent traces are assumed to have the first trace's sample count.
programs.difficulty_reason: It decodes a sequence of independently compressed traces using the wavelet-packet library.

test_cases.description: Round-trip multiple traces using the default error.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | sustrip | wpc1comp2 n1=128 error=0.01 | wpc1uncomp2 > out.bin

test_cases.description: Round-trip a non-power-of-two trace length with a larger error.
test_cases.command: suspike nt=100 ntr=8 | sustrip | wpc1comp2 n1=100 error=0.05 | wpc1uncomp2 > out.bin

programs.name: wpccompress
programs.purpose: Compress a two-dimensional binary-float section using wavelet packets in both dimensions.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: WPCCOMPRESS --- COMPRESS a 2D section using Wavelet Packets

params.name: n1
params.description: Number of samples in the first dimension.

params.name: n2
params.description: Number of samples in the second dimension.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Two-dimensional wavelet-packet compression and quantization depend on floating-point calculations and rounding; small differences can change the encoded stream. The compressed format is platform dependent.
programs.difficulty_reason: It buffers a full two-dimensional section and delegates wavelet-packet compression and encoding to a substantial library.

test_cases.description: Compress a section with the default error.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 | sustrip | wpccompress n1=128 n2=16 error=0.01 > out.wpc

test_cases.description: Compress a section with non-power-of-two dimensions and a larger error.
test_cases.command: suspike nt=100 ntr=9 | sustrip | wpccompress n1=100 n2=9 error=0.05 > out.wpc
